meta.name: Format NVM
meta.description: Low level formats the NVM media, changing LBA data size and/or metadata size. May destroy all data and metadata in affected namespaces.

nsid.desc: Namespace Identifier. Use 0xFFFFFFFF to format all namespaces (subject to FNA field in Identify Controller).

lbafl.desc: LBA Format Lower: least significant 4 bits of the Format Index of the User Data Format to apply.

lbafu.desc: LBA Format Upper: most significant 2 bits of the Format Index. Ignored if LBAFEE is cleared to 0h in Host Behavior Support feature.

mset.desc: Metadata Settings: I/O Command Set specific. 0 = metadata transferred as separate buffer; 1 = metadata transferred as part of extended data LBA.

pi.desc: Protection Information: I/O Command Set specific. Specifies whether protection information is enabled and the type (Type 1, 2, or 3).

pil.desc: Protection Information Location: I/O Command Set specific. 0 = last 8 bytes of metadata; 1 = first 8 bytes of metadata.

ses.desc: Secure Erase Settings: 000b = no secure erase; 001b = User Data Erase; 010b = Cryptographic Erase; 011b-111b = Reserved.

LBAFU.desc: LBA Format Upper (most significant 2 bits of Format Index)

RSVD2.desc: Reserved — PIL and PI are I/O Command Set specific

LBAFL.desc: LBA Format Lower (least significant 4 bits of Format Index)

status_rules.condition: Command succeeds — valid format applied to the specified namespace
Invalid format specified (e.g. invalid User Data Format number, insufficient metadata resources, or format not available in current configuration)
I/O commands in progress on the affected namespace when Format NVM was submitted
status_rules.note: Figure 190. DNR=false — command may succeed if resubmitted after I/O quiesces.

status_rules.condition: Format denied due to lack of access rights (security specification violation)
Access to namespace or user data denied due to lack of access rights
NSID set to 0xFFFFFFFF but FNA bit 3 is set to 1 (broadcast NSID not supported)
status_rules.note: Section 5.14: controller shall abort if bit 3 of FNA is 1 and NSID=0xFFFFFFFF

response.note: Format NVM has no data transfer. After successful completion, the new format settings are visible via Identify Namespace.
